retainedDiagnostics.description: First browser contrast parser selected the transparent fade start rather than the first nontransparent text-region stop. Parser corrected and all 18 scenarios rerun.
Legacy synthetic configuration lacked post_edit; setup used setdefault. Theme already defaults absent fields to disabled.

limitations: Author bounded Chromium checks only; independent review, real Safari/physical phones/screen reader and complete 1.0 contract remain pending.
White backgrounds and long titles changed only the isolated browser DOM after checking the actual article editor; no fixture content was saved.
White-cover contrast bound covers article title/metadata with mask.header enabled; mask off and navigation contrast are not accepted by this record.
Previous source/package evidence remains historical and is not relabeled for this candidate.
